bifrost: springboard/render/src/font.rs, springboard/render/src/cff.rs, springboard/render/src/gvar.rs, springboard/render/src/fontprefs.rs, springboard/render/src/emoji.rs, springboard/sdk/src/attributed.rs, springboard/sdk/src/layer_kinds/text.rs, springboard/ui/src/text.rs, springboard/src/shell/browser/layout2/text.rs
summary: BifrOSt has a TrueType and CFF font engine with metrics, cmap glyph lookup, variable-font axes and an attributed string model with line wrapping and truncation. It has no app-facing font objects, font manager, OpenType shaping (kerning, ligatures outside colour emoji), paragraph styles, tabs, ruby, bidi or vertical text.

features.note: The renderer parses a font file into a Font; apps get no font object or descriptor type. Faces are chosen by settings (font_system, font_mono), not by app request.

features.feature: Font collections and font manager (registration, enumeration, activation)
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-core-text, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. fontprefs::installed lists one face per family from a directory, for Settings only. There is no runtime register/unregister, no collections, no auto-activation and no font-changed notification.
cmap formats 4 and 12 (Unicode) and CFF glyph names. Misses return .notdef (glyph 0). No CTGlyphInfo-style mapping override and no font fallback cascade.

features.apple: CTFontGetAscent, CTFontGetDescent, CTFontGetLeading, CTFontGetCapHeight, CTFontGetXHeight, CTFontGetUnderlinePosition
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/font.rs (ascent, descent from hhea; advance from hmtx; measure)
features.note: Ascent, descent and advance widths only. Leading, cap height, x-height and underline metrics are not read.
TrueType glyf and CFF Type 2 outlines are rasterised into images. No path object is exposed to apps and no direct glyph drawing API.
fvar, avar and gvar are applied in the renderer. The SDK does not expose axis values to apps; weights come from the Weight enum.

features.apple: CTTypesetter shaping via GSUB and GPOS, kCTFontOpenTypeFeatureTag
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-core-text, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No GPOS and no kern table reader. Plain text is laid out by summing advances, so pairs are not kerned. No OpenType feature selection.

features.apple: Styling Attributed Strings: kCTFontAttributeName, kCTForegroundColorAttributeName, kCTUnderlineStyleAttributeName, kCTBackgroundColorAttributeName
features.note: Bold, italic (stored, drawn upright), size class, colour token, underline, strikethrough and link. No arbitrary font, colour, background colour or baseline attributes. Ranges count characters, not UTF-16 units.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 21 tests. Only line wrapping and head, middle and tail truncation. No alignment, indents, spacing, tab stops or line-height settings on attributed strings.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 21 tests. Greedy word wrap and binary-search truncation against a caller-supplied measure function. No grapheme or script-aware break rules beyond whitespace. Browser layout has its own wrapper in springboard/src/shell/browser/layout2/text.rs.

features.feature: Line and run layout objects (typesetter, framesetter, line, run, frame)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 3 tests. Wave 5 (theme-03, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No layout object exposed to apps and no glyph run or line geometry query. RichTextView::draw wraps styled runs into a Surface, and the text buffer handles editing. Caret and hit-testing are not in draw.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Wave 2 (theme-32, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No bidi algorithm and no right-to-left layout in the text path.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 4 (theme-17, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No vertical layout.

features.bifrost: none found in the text modules
features.note: No ruby text. Low priority outside CJK locales.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. Wave 4 (theme-24, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No way to place an image or view inside styled text.

features.feature: Font family substitution, system designs and cascade lists
features.apple: CTFontDescriptorCreateMatchingFontDescriptors, CTFontDescriptorCreateWithNameAndSize, kCTFontCascadeListAttribute, CTFontCopyDefaultCascadeListForLanguages, system design (rounded, serif, monospaced)
features.note: A family the library lacks resolves to an open equivalent by class (grotesque, geometric, humanist, serif, slab, script, mono, rounded, CJK gothic/mincho/kai/rounded); unknown names fall back by traits. with_design maps rounded/serif/monospaced; cascade_list orders script families per language tag. Matching returns Installed records, not descriptor objects with mandatory-key sets; equivalents are other designs, and the listed open families must be installed in the font library. Not yet checked on Midget.

gaps: No app-facing font object or font manager: apps cannot choose a font by family, weight or size from a font descriptor.
No OpenType shaping: no GPOS or kern reader, no ligatures outside colour emoji, no feature selection.
No line or run layout objects for apps: CTLine and CTFramesetter equivalents are missing, so apps cannot measure or hit-test laid-out text.
No paragraph styles: alignment, indents, line spacing and tab stops are missing from the attributed model.
No bidirectional or vertical text layout.
Font metrics are limited to ascent, descent and advance: leading, cap height, x-height and underline position are not read.
No font fallback (cascade) for characters missing from the chosen face: missing glyphs render as .notdef.
No runtime font registration or font-changed notification; installed faces are listed only in Settings.
